newsitem.title: USA: Regis buys seven salons, terms withheld.
newsitem.headline: Regis buys seven salons, terms withheld.

text.p: Regis Corp, a large owner and operator of mall-based hair and retail product salons, said Monday it acquired seven salons from its Trade Secret franchisee which generate about $2.5 million in annual sales.
Terms of the transactions were withheld.
Of the total, two are located in Louisville, Ky.; one in Lexington, Ky.; two in Cincinnati, Ohio; and two in Indiana.
Including these transactions, Regis has completed 46 acquisitions in the past 32 months, adding 476 salons and about $118 million in annual sales.
